senses.gloss: (II)--a measurement, eight times the यूका (s.v.) M. २५८. १८.
--on the नर्मदा, no rebirth after a bath there. M. १९१. ८८-89.

--an asura who, induced by नारद besieged मथुरा with three crores of म्लेच्छस्; saw कृष्ण and ran [page३-020+ ३७] towards him when he fled to a cave. Yavana followed him and in the cave saw somebody sleeping; thought it was कृष्ण and kicked him, when he woke up and burnt the asura to ashes by his energy. The sleeping person was Mucukunda (s.v.).
1: भा. X. ५०. ४४; ५१. 1-२३, ४२.
Thus he was vanquished by कृष्ण.
2: Ib. II. 7. ३४; X. ३७. १६; Br. III. ७३. १०२; वा. ९८. १०२.
--had no son, and hence appointed गार्ग्य to bless him with one; this son was कालयवन. Vi. V. २३. 4-5.
(I)--(यशस्य) one of the seven divisions of प्लक्षद्वीप. भा. V. २०. 3.
(I)--the son of द्विमीढ, and father of कृतिमान्. भा. IX. २१. २७; वा. ९९. १८४.
(II)--a son of भर्म्याश्व (हर्यश्व-वि। प्।) भा. IX. २१. ३२; Vi. IV. १९. ५९.
(III)--a son of अजमीढ and धूमिनी M. ४९. ७०.
(IV)--the son of द्विजामीढ and father of धृतिमान्. Vi. IV. १९. ४८-9.
--a pupil of कृत. Br. II. ३५. ५३; वा. ६१. ४६.
